en: I want [数量] [量词] of [东西]
speaker: customer
why: 我要 = I want. Number + measure word + thing is how Chinese counts anything: 两碗面, 一瓶可乐.

speaker: customer
why: 'many-few money?' No 吗 needed: 多少 already makes it a question.

speaker: bot
why: Prices are spoken with 块: 三十六块 = 36 yuan.

speaker: bot
why: 'No need to be polite.' The standard answer to 谢谢.

speaker: bot
why: 'Please use slowly': what staff say when the food arrives.

speaker: customer
why: Statement + 吗 = yes/no question. 有牛肉面 (there is beef noodles) → 有牛肉面吗? (is there?)

speaker: bot
why: To say yes, repeat the verb: 有吗? → 有.

speaker: bot
why: 没有 = don't have; 了 = that changed: 'there was some, now there's none'.

en: Bring me [数量] [量词] of [东西]
speaker: customer
why: The casual way to order: 'come, one bowl'. Same slots as 我要.

speaker: customer
why: 不要 = don't want. 不 becomes bú before a 4th tone (yào).

speaker: customer
why: Place comes before the verb: 在这儿 (at here) 吃 (eat).

speaker: bot
why: A 还是 B = A or B? No 吗: 还是 already makes it a question.

en: OK, I'll pack it for you
speaker: bot
bot
why: 一共 = all together. 一 becomes yí before a 4th tone (gòng).

template: 算了，我要 [数量][量词][东西]
pinyin: suànle, wǒ yào [数量][量词][东西]
en: Forget it, I want [数量] [量词] of [东西]
speaker: customer
why: 算了 cancels what came before. Only what follows counts.

speaker: customer
why: 再 = again. 'Again bring one': one more of the same.
